origin.details: pillar.neg defaults to true, so the text is red. Set it to false and the text is returned as it is. An empty string stays empty. A missing value is drawn as the letters NA when the option is on, and stays missing when it is off.
origin.value: A character vector of the same length.

translation.description: The same red. None is missing. A string is one element and a list is the vector.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A string, None, a number, or a list of those.

translation.details: pillar.neg defaults to true. Only a real True enables the red. An empty string stays empty. With the option on, a missing value is the letters NA. With it off, as.character leaves a missing value missing. Set cli.num_colors first. One color pastes the text.
translation.value: A string when x is a single value, or a list when x is a list.

from cli._options import options as cli_options

cli_options(**{"cli.num_colors": 8})
